title: Igitangaza c'Intebe y'Ubwami ya kure
intro: Umwami w’ububasha, yahezagiwe n’ububasha budasanzwe, yarashikiwe n’ingorane idasanzwe yerekeye umwamikazi wo mu gihugu ca kure. Umwami yararondeye kwerekana ububasha n’ubukerebutsi vy’Imana, ashiraho ikintu kidasanzwe cari giteye kubiri n’amategeko y’igihe n’ahantu. Woba ushobora gutahura ido n’ido ry’ico kintu c’igitangaro cabaye?
clues: Umutware yahabwa ububasha buhambaye cane, harimwo no kuganza ibiremwa bitaboneka be n’ubushobozi bwo gutegeka imiyaga.
Uwo mutware yararonse inkuru y’umwamikazi w’umutunzi wari asenga izuba, aca afata ingingo yo kumutumira ku kirimba.
Imbere y’uko uwo mwamikazi ashika, uwo mutware yaseruye icipfuzo co kuzana intebe yiwe nziza cane y’ubutegetsi avuye mu bwami bwiwe bwa kure.
Igijini gikomeye cane carasavye gukura ico kintu imbere y’uko uwo mutware ahaguruka ava mu nama yiwe.
Ariko rero, uwufise ubumenyi bwimbitse bw’Ivyanditswe vy’Imana yaratanga uburyo bwo kuronka mbere vyihuta kuruta, akarangiza ico gikorwa mu kanya nk’ako gukubita urugohe.
Igihe cashika, uwo mutware yategetse ko ico kintu gihindurwa kugira ngo bagerageze ubwenge bw’umwamikazi be n’ukuntu abona ibintu igihe azoba ashitse ku kirimba.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
